title: Harness handoff
description: The state of an in-flight task, written to .harness/workspace/<ID>/handoff.json so the work survives a context reset. `/implement` reads `stage` to decide what to skip, which makes this the most consequential file in the harness: an optimistic or malformed handoff makes the next session skip work that never happened.

stage.description: The last stage actually COMPLETED. If unsure whether a stage finished, record the earlier one: over-reporting makes the next session skip real work.

summary.description: What has actually been done, in two or three sentences.

gates.description: Record red gates too. A branch nobody knows the test status of is worse than a red one.

next.description: The agent or person who should continue.

notes_for_next.description: The thing you would say out loud if you could hand this over in person. The most valuable field here, and worth nothing if it is optimistic.
